title: OutputRowsResponse
description: Response for GET /api/outputs/:id/rows?offset=&limit=&sort=&filter= (HEL-906 cycle 7, extended HEL-1027). `sort` (`<column>:<asc|desc>`) and `filter` (URL-encoded JSON `{quick?, columns?}`, matching `TableColumnFilters`' case-insensitive substring semantics) are query parameters, not part of this body -- see openspec/specs/output-routes-api/spec.md for their full contract. HEL-1027: when `filter` is present and non-empty, `total` reflects the count of rows matching the filter (not the Output's raw row count) -- the same value the client derives `hasMore` from (`offset + limit < total`). `materialized` is independent of a filter's match count: `false` only when the bound node has never had a successful pipeline run at all -- a filter that legitimately matches zero rows of an Output with real data is `materialized: true`.

items.description: The requested page's rows, each an arbitrary JSON object keyed by column name.

total.description: Row count for the current `sort`/`filter` -- the Output's raw row count when `filter` is absent or empty, the filtered row count otherwise.

materialized.description: False only when the bound node has never had a successful pipeline run since the Output was added -- never derived from a filter's match count.
